name: V-PLUGIN-SQL-RUN
description: Run SQL, direct, on PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server and SQLite: a script split the database's own way with :name parameters and typed rows back, no WAVE transaction, a Template body, an expression SQL row, TLS with a verified certificate and a driver option per database; a Finally path drops every table the run made.

data.label: Try/Catch
data.description: Run SQL and drop what it made

values.sql:
INSERT INTO sqlrun_pg___TOKEN__ (id, name, qty) VALUES (3, 'kept without a transaction', 1);
INSERT INTO sqlrun_pg_missing___TOKEN__ (id) VALUES (4);
SELECT id, name, qty FROM {{ pg_table }} WHERE id >= 2 ORDER BY id
f"SELECT id, qty FROM {pg_table} WHERE qty >= :min_qty ORDER BY id"
SELECT s.ssl, s.version, s.client_dn, current_setting('application_name') AS app, '{{ pg_table }}' AS plain_text FROM pg_stat_ssl AS s WHERE s.pid = pg_backend_pid()
